texts.value: Catalyzes the oxidation of D-2-hydroxyglutarate (D-2-HG) to alpha-ketoglutarate (PubMed:15070399, PubMed:15609246, PubMed:16037974, PubMed:20020533, PubMed:33431826). Also catalyzes the oxidation of other D-2-hydroxyacids, such as D-malate (D-MAL) and D-lactate (D-LAC) (PubMed:33431826). Exhibits high activities towards D-2-HG and D-MAL but a very weak activity towards D-LAC (PubMed:33431826)
Activated by zinc and cobalt ions

disease.description: A rare recessive neurometabolic disorder causing developmental delay, epilepsy, hypotonia, and dysmorphic features. Both a mild and a severe phenotype exist. The severe phenotype is homogeneous and is characterized by early infantile-onset epileptic encephalopathy and cardiomyopathy. The mild phenotype has a more variable clinical presentation. Diagnosis is based on the presence of an excess of D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
Belongs to the FAD-binding oxidoreductase/transferase type 4 family
